note: Industrial opportunity surfaces — analytical hypotheses about where capability is thin, not investment recommendations. Mapped onto existing SID opportunity-surface entities rather than creating new ones.

linked_existing_sid_opportunity_surfaces.name: MEMS IMU manufacturing for UAV guidance

questions.what_exists_in_india: At least three Indian companies market full flight-controller + GNSS + power-module stacks (Arkin AeroMind/Navroc, YARI V6X, Zerosum autopilots), plus GNSS-denied navigation (Zerosum).
questions.what_is_imported: MCU/SoC, MEMS IMU and GNSS chipsets — not disclosed by any of them; the existing Atlas scores these as high-risk import layers.
questions.what_is_only_assembled: Unknown — design + board assembly claimed; no facility or EMS partner evidenced.
questions.what_is_technologically_weak: Silicon (MCU, IMU, GNSS RF front-end); no NavIC support claims were verified.
questions.what_is_scaling: Not evidenced — no production volumes or named OEM adopters.
questions.what_is_still_unknown: Semiconductor BOM, OEM adoption, DGCA-certified platforms using these controllers.

surfaces.label: Industrial opportunity surface
surfaces.validation_status: Validated (as a dependency, not a capability)

questions.what_exists_in_india: Distribution and design-support for drone electronics; one foreign-owned interconnect maker with stated Bengaluru manufacturing.
questions.what_is_imported: Processors/MCUs, CMOS sensors, GNSS/cellular modules, MOSFETs, Hall sensors, BMS ICs — offered from globally sourced brands.
questions.what_is_scaling: Distributor drone portfolios exist, which implies demand, but volume is not evidenced.
questions.evidence: L3 company portfolios + existing Atlas sovereignty table.
questions.what_is_still_unknown: Named line cards; which brands dominate Indian drone BOMs.

questions.what_exists_in_india: An Indian ESC line (YARI, claim). No verified Indian drone-grade BLDC motor maker in the intake.
questions.what_is_imported: Motors and ESCs (T-MOTOR exhibited directly), NdFeB magnets, ESC power silicon.
questions.what_is_technologically_weak: Magnets, bearings and power semiconductors; motor manufacturing not evidenced.
questions.what_is_scaling: Global supplier presence is scaling (T-MOTOR direct).
questions.what_is_still_unknown: Whether Tobitek/Thrust Link manufacture motors, and their magnet source.

entities: Rangsons Aerospace (EW capability, no C-UAS system evidenced)

questions.what_exists_in_india: Positioning only; the existing C-UAS register (60 systems / 43 makers) is unchanged.

questions.what_exists_in_india: A private UAV maker delivering to the Army (Drogo: 41 JK 250e first batch, ₹72 crore, June 2026, L2) and moving into loitering munitions with a DPSU (MIL MoU, Sep 2026); an IIT-incubated developer with an industrial backer and a planned factory (VU Dynamics / PATH).
questions.what_is_only_assembled: Drogo integration in India implied by delivery; content unknown.
questions.what_is_technologically_weak: Bill-of-materials transparency; no MoD primary contract document located.
questions.what_is_scaling: Yes — prototype-to-production transition evidenced for Drogo; capital/industrial backing for VU Dynamics.
questions.what_is_still_unknown: Completion of Drogo order; VU Dynamics ownership and factory status.
